title: Umuntu Utavuzwe Izina Warwanyije Ishyanga Ritakirana
intro: Mu mpapuro za Korowani, hari abantu amazina yabo yahishwe kugira ngo tuzirikane amasomo yabo. Umwe muri abo bantu yavukiye mu gihugu cyari cyaranze intumwa zacyo, nyamara uyu muntu yari afite ukwemera kwihishe kwamutandukanyaga n'abandi. Ubwo irimbuka ryari ryegereje, uyu muntu yahagaze neza mu kwemera kwe kw'ibanga. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo muntu w'amayobera utanga umuburo ku bantu be mbere y'uko itegeko rya nyuma rimanuka?
clues: Nabaye mu bantu bari barahakanye kenshi intumwa Allah yari yabatumyeho.
Bitandukanye n’umuryango wanjye, namenye ukuri ubwo intumwa yazaga ifite ibimenyetso bisobanutse biturutse ku Mwami wanjye.
Nahishe ukwizera kwanjye abankandamizaga, nzi ko bazangirira nabi baramutse bavumbuye ukwemera kwanjye.
Igihe itegeko ryo guhana ryari ryegereje, natangaje ku mugaragaro ko ndi indahemuka kandi mburira abantu banjye kwikiza.
Nabibukije ko ndi intumwa yizewe, ntaho ntaniye n'aboherejwe mbere, kandi ko batagomba gusenga uretse Allah.
Abantu banjye banshinjaga ubupfumu n'ubusazi, nyamara igihano bari baraburiwe cyarabagezeho.
